preservation: All 30 supplied PNGs are preserved byte-for-byte; supplied-images.json records their SHA-256 hashes.

historical_outputs: Supplied CIFAR confusion matrices, AAPL plots, and GAN snapshots are historical source results, not new measured runs. Extra source screenshots remain archived without duplicating their contents on additional slides.
